tooltip.jaymospowers.fit.barbed: Barbed hook: a hooked fish takes line back slowly
tooltip.jaymospowers.fit.braided: Braided line: takes more strain before it snaps
tooltip.jaymospowers.fit.weighted: Weighted line: the hook sinks fast
message.jaymospowers.fishing.note_read: You copy the scrap into your journal.
message.jaymospowers.fishing.note_known: Your journal has this one already.
gui.jaymospowers.journal.hint.cavefish: A torn scrap: "...pale and blind, in the still pools far under the hills. Keeps to the bottom. Bait that lies there..."
gui.jaymospowers.journal.hint.olm: A torn scrap: "...slow, and wants it cold and dark. Not a fish for the sun. Leave the bait on the bottom and wait..."
gui.jaymospowers.journal.hint.ember_tila: A torn scrap: "...in the fire lakes the big ones hang at middle depth, not at the top. Let a lure sink before you reel..."
gui.jaymospowers.journal.hint.cinder_pup: A torn scrap: "...tiny, right at the top, along the warm edge of the lava. Not worth a big hook..."
